page.title: Outage alerts
page.description: Which silent sources page someone, and which are only recorded. Times are UTC.
page.summaryForbidden: Monitored sources covered and Source overrides in the class table come from the fleet summary, which your role cannot read (permission read:fleet); those two columns are left blank. The policy below is complete.
page.summaryFailed: The source counts are not shown: the fleet summary could not be loaded. The policy below is complete; grace is given in buckets only.
page.failureForbidden: The outage alert policy cannot be shown to your role.
page.failureFailed: The outage alert policy could not be shown.
page.note: Record only still records the outage: the silence is detected, stays on the source and on /behavior, and follows its normal lifecycle. It only stops that anomaly from raising an alert. An alert that is already open resolves normally. Only NO_EVENTS is affected; volume drops and spikes still alert.

unit.monitoredSource: {count, plural, one {{n} monitored source} other {{n} monitored sources}}

grace.blank: Enter a whole number of buckets, or leave it blank for the default.

impact.unknownDefault: The default mode is not reported, so the effect of this change cannot be counted here.
impact.sameRemoval: {class} already resolves to {mode}; removing the row changes no mode.
impact.unknownCountStop: {class} will no longer raise outage alerts. The number of sources affected is unavailable because the fleet summary could not be read.
impact.unknownCountRaise: {class} will raise outage alerts. The number of sources affected is unavailable because the fleet summary could not be read.
impact.none: No monitored source in {class} is decided by this row, so no source changes behaviour.
impact.stop: {who} will no longer raise outage alerts.
impact.keepAlerting: {count, plural, one {{n} source keeps alerting through its own override.} other {{n} sources keep alerting through their own overrides.}}
impact.stayRecordOnly: {count, plural, one {{n} source stays record-only through its own override.} other {{n} sources stay record-only through their own overrides.}}
impact.graceChanged: A silent source is judged after {to} instead of {from}.
impact.sourceUnknown: {name} falls back to the mode of {class}, which is not reported here, so the effect cannot be stated.
impact.sourceSameRemoval: {name} already resolves to {mode}; removing the override changes no mode.
impact.sourceStop: {name} will no longer raise outage alerts.
impact.pinned: {class} resolves to {mode} as well, so this override pins the source against a later change to its class.
impact.differs: {class} resolves to {mode}; this source differs from it.
impact.sourceGrace: It is judged silent after {to} instead of {from}.
impact.goneRow: This row governs no source: its source is no longer in the inventory. Removing it changes no behaviour.

failure.forbidden: Your role cannot change the outage alert policy (permission admin:outage). Nothing was changed.
failure.gone: This row was already removed by someone else. The list has been reloaded.
failure.readForbidden: Your role cannot read the outage alert policy (permission admin:outage). Reading it needs the same permission as changing it. Nothing was changed.
failure.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
failure.readFailed: The outage alert policy could not be loaded, so nothing is shown here. The backend may be unreachable; check that it is running, then reload the page. Nothing was changed.

manager.reloadFailed: {text} The list could not be reloaded, so the counts may be out of date. Reload the page.
manager.reloadFailedGone: {text} The list could not be reloaded either. Reload the page.
manager.emptyText: Every monitored source raises an alert when it goes silent, which is the default. Set a policy on a class, or override one source, to record its outages without alerting.
manager.noOverrides: No source is overridden. A source follows its class, or the default.
manager.modeUnreadable: a mode the page cannot read
manager.savedSource: Saved. {name} is now {mode}, set on the source.

classes.emptyTitle: No class has a monitored source.
classes.emptyText: The fleet summary lists no enabled source and no class row exists, so there is nothing to decide here yet.
classes.caption: One row per class: the mode its silent sources resolve to, where that comes from, the grace, and how many sources it covers.
classes.savedDefaultGrace: Saved. {name} is now {mode} with the default grace.

sources.caption: Sources whose outage mode or grace is set on the source itself, and who last changed each. Times are UTC.
sources.removedGone: Removed the override of a source that is no longer in the inventory.
sources.removed: Removed the override of {name}. It follows its class again.

picker.emptyQuery: No log source has a name or type containing “{query}”.
picker.empty: The inventory lists no log source.
